experimental_index.ddl: CREATE INDEX perf_trial_active_kickoff_idx ON v2_fixtures(kickoff_at,id) WHERE phase IN ('live','scheduled')

sql.query: SELECT id,source_id,sport,competition_id,competition_name,home_team,away_team,kickoff_at,phase,match_state,home_score,away_score,clock_minute,source_updated_at,received_at FROM v2_fixtures WHERE phase IN ('live','scheduled') ORDER BY kickoff_at,id LIMIT 51

author_message_page.query: SELECT m.id,m.raw_text,m.media_objects,m.media_state,m.posted_at,m.edited_at,m.revision,m.deleted_at,e.display_nickname,j.state AS analysis_state,j.last_error AS analysis_error FROM v2_expert_messages m JOIN v2_experts e ON e.id=m.expert_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT state,last_error FROM v2_analysis_jobs WHERE message_id=m.id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) j ON TRUE WHERE m.expert_id=$1 ORDER BY m.posted_at DESC,m.id DESC LIMIT 31

detail_fixture.query: SELECT id,home_team,away_team,phase,kickoff_at FROM v2_fixtures WHERE id=$1

detail_quotes.query: SELECT id,market_id,market_name,period,market_kind,line,selection,price,status,is_main,score_basis,source_updated_at,received_at FROM v2_current_quotes WHERE fixture_id=$1 ORDER BY market_id,line,selection LIMIT 500

detail_signals.query: SELECT s.id,s.expert_id,e.display_nickname,s.market_id,s.line,s.selection,s.recommendation_price,s.outcome,s.unit_net FROM v2_expert_signals s JOIN v2_experts e ON e.id=s.expert_id WHERE s.fixture_id=$1 ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

homepage_fixture_page.query: SELECT id,source_id,sport,competition_id,competition_name,home_team,away_team,kickoff_at,phase,match_state,home_score,away_score,clock_minute,source_updated_at,received_at FROM v2_fixtures WHERE phase IN ('live','scheduled') ORDER BY kickoff_at,id LIMIT 51

homepage_quote_summary.query: WITH ranked AS (SELECT id AS quote_id,fixture_id,market_id,market_name,period,market_kind,line,selection,price,status,is_main,source_updated_at,received_at,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY fixture_id ORDER BY is_main DESC,source_updated_at DESC NULLS LAST,market_id,line,selection) AS position FROM v2_current_quotes WHERE fixture_id=ANY($1::text[])) SELECT quote_id,fixture_id,market_id,market_name,period,market_kind,line,selection,price,status,is_main,source_updated_at,received_at FROM ranked WHERE position<=24 ORDER BY fixture_id,market_id,line,selection

Plans.Filter: ((lower(home_team) ~~ '%perf club 000%'::text) OR (lower(away_team) ~~ '%perf club 000%'::text) OR ('perf club 000'::text = ANY (home_aliases)) OR ('perf club 000'::text = ANY (away_aliases)))

review_candidate_selection.query: SELECT f.id,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY f.kickoff_at,f.id),to_jsonb(f) FROM v2_fixtures f WHERE f.phase IN ('live','scheduled') AND ($1='all' OR f.phase=$1) AND (lower(f.home_team) LIKE $2 OR lower(f.away_team) LIKE $2 OR $3=ANY(f.home_aliases) OR $3=ANY(f.away_aliases)) AND ($4='' OR lower(f.competition_name) LIKE '%'||$4||'%') AND ($5::timestamptz IS NULL OR f.kickoff_at >= $5) AND ($6::timestamptz IS NULL OR f.kickoff_at <= $6)

Plans.Filter: ((CASE WHEN (outcome = 'pending'::text) THEN created_at ELSE COALESCE(settled_at, created_at) END >= '2026-09-27 16:59:33.090487+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (CASE WHEN (outcome = 'pending'::text) THEN created_at ELSE COALESCE(settled_at, created_at) END < '2026-10-28 16:59:33.090487+00'::timestamp with time zone))

((NOT (score_baseline IS DISTINCT FROM s.score_baseline)) AND (fixture_id = s.fixture_id) AND (market_id = s.market_id) AND (period = s.period) AND (line = s.line) AND (selection = s.selection) AND (price = s.recommendation_price) AND (source_updated_at = s.quote_time) AND ((evidence ->> 'score_basis'::text) = s.score_basis))
((NOT (unit_net IS DISTINCT FROM s.unit_net)) AND (fixture_id = s.fixture_id) AND (outcome = s.outcome) AND (effective_stake = s.effective_stake) AND (reason = s.settlement_reason))

Sort Key: (COALESCE(sum(checked.unit_net) FILTER (WHERE (((checked.quote_valid AND ((checked.outcome = 'pending'::text) OR checked.settlement_valid))) AND (checked.outcome <> 'pending'::text))), '0'::numeric)) DESC

statistics_aggregation.query: WITH checked AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT s.*,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM v2_quote_evidence q WHERE q.evidence_kind='expert_signal' AND q.reference_id=s.id AND q.fixture_id=s.fixture_id AND q.market_id=s.market_id AND q.period=s.period AND q.line=s.line AND q.selection=s.selection AND q.price=s.recommendation_price AND q.source_updated_at=s.quote_time AND q.score_baseline IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.score_baseline AND q.evidence->>'score_basis'=s.score_basis) AS quote_valid,(s.settled_at IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM v2_signal_settlements l JOIN v2_fixture_results r ON r.fixture_id=l.fixture_id AND r.version=l.result_version WHERE l.signal_id=s.id AND l.fixture_id=s.fixture_id AND l.result_version=s.result_version AND l.outcome=s.outcome AND l.unit_net IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.unit_net AND l.effective_stake=s.effective_stake AND l.reason=s.settlement_reason AND r.status IN ('confirmed','void') AND r.version=(SELECT max(x.version) FROM v2_fixture_results x WHERE x.fixture_id=s.fixture_id))) AS settlement_valid FROM v2_expert_signals s WHERE (CASE WHEN s.outcome='pending' THEN s.created_at ELSE COALESCE(s.settled_at,s.created_at) END)>=$1 AND (CASE WHEN s.outcome='pending' THEN s.created_at ELSE COALESCE(s.settled_at,s.created_at) END)<$2 AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM v2_expert_messages m WHERE m.id=s.message_id AND m.source_id=$3)) AND ($4::text='all' OR s.phase=$4) AND ($5::text='all' OR s.market_kind=$5) AND ($6::uuid IS NULL OR s.expert_id=$6)) ,scoped AS (SELECT checked.*,quote_valid AND (outcome='pending' OR settlement_valid) AS statistics_eligible FROM checked) SELECT e.id,e.display_nickname,e.avatar_object_key,e.enabled,COUNT(s.id) AS total_signals,COUNT(s.id) FILTER(WHERE s.statistics_eligible) AS eligible_signals,COUNT(s.id) FILTER(WHERE NOT s.statistics_eligible) AS excluded_signals,COUNT(s.id) FILTER(WHERE NOT s.quote_valid) AS missing_quote_evidence,COUNT(s.id) FILTER(WHERE s.quote_valid AND s.outcome<>'pending' AND NOT s.settlement_valid) AS invalid_settlement_evidence,COUNT(s.id) FILTER(WHERE s.statistics_eligible AND s.outcome='pending') AS pending,COUNT(s.id) FILTER(WHERE s.statistics_eligible AND s.outcome='win') AS win,COUNT(s.id) FILTER(WHERE s.statistics_eligible AND s.outcome='half_win') AS half_win,COUNT(s.id) FILTER(WHERE s.statistics_eligible AND s.outcome='loss') AS loss,COUNT(s.id) FILTER(WHERE s.statistics_eligible AND s.outcome='half_loss') AS half_loss,COUNT(s.id) FILTER(WHERE s.statistics_eligible AND s.outcome='push') AS push,COUNT(s.id) FILTER(WHERE s.statistics_eligible AND s.outcome='void') AS void,COALESCE(SUM(s.unit_net) FILTER(WHERE s.statistics_eligible AND s.outcome<>'pending'),0) AS unit_net,COALESCE(SUM(s.effective_stake) FILTER(WHERE s.statistics_eligible AND s.outcome<>'pending'),0) AS effective_stake FROM v2_experts e LEFT JOIN scoped s ON s.expert_id=e.id WHERE e.enabled AND ($6::uuid IS NULL OR e.id=$6) GROUP BY e.id ORDER BY unit_net DESC,total_signals DESC,e.display_nickname,e.id

Plans.Filter: ((CASE WHEN (outcome = 'pending'::text) THEN created_at ELSE COALESCE(settled_at, created_at) END >= '2026-09-27 16:59:33.090487+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (CASE WHEN (outcome = 'pending'::text) THEN created_at ELSE COALESCE(settled_at, created_at) END < '2026-10-28 16:59:33.090487+00'::timestamp with time zone))

statistics_source_options.query: WITH scoped AS (SELECT s.* FROM v2_expert_signals s WHERE (CASE WHEN s.outcome='pending' THEN s.created_at ELSE COALESCE(s.settled_at,s.created_at) END)>=$1 AND (CASE WHEN s.outcome='pending' THEN s.created_at ELSE COALESCE(s.settled_at,s.created_at) END)<$2 AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM v2_expert_messages m WHERE m.id=s.message_id AND m.source_id=$3)) AND ($4::text='all' OR s.phase=$4) AND ($5::text='all' OR s.market_kind=$5) AND ($6::uuid IS NULL OR s.expert_id=$6)) SELECT DISTINCT x.id,x.display_name FROM v2_expert_sources x JOIN v2_expert_messages m ON m.source_id=x.id JOIN scoped s ON s.message_id=m.id JOIN v2_experts e ON e.id=s.expert_id WHERE x.enabled AND e.enabled ORDER BY x.display_name,x.id
